How Quick Add works
Type tokens separated by spaces (each space becomes "; " as you type). Press Enter or tap Log.
Daily Log
D <S/R> <subject> <chapter> <HH:MM> [date]
S = Studied, R = Revision. e.g. D S Physics 3 02:30
MCQ Result
MCQ <subject> <chapter> <total> <correct> <wrong> <skipped> <HH:MM> [date]
e.g. MCQ Chemistry 5 25 20 3 2 00:30
Task
td <CamelCaseText> [date]
CamelCase becomes spaced text. e.g. td BuyNewNotebook
[date] (optional, defaults to today)
in3day — 3 days from now  ·  25-12 or 25-12-25 — explicit date
Wallet Entry
WAL <in/exp> <category> <amount> [note] [date]
e.g. WAL exp Food 150 LunchWithFriends
Exam
EXAM <CamelCaseName> <date> [subject] [HH:MM]
e.g. EXAM PhysicsFinal in5day Physics 10:00
Note
NOTE <CamelCaseTitle> [CamelCaseBody]
e.g. NOTE ExamStrategy ReviewWeakChaptersFirst
Add to Routine
ROUTINE <CamelCaseGroupName> <subject> [date] [HH:MM]
Reuses the group if it already exists. e.g. ROUTINE WeeklyBatch Physics in2day
New Subject
SUBJ <CamelCaseName> <key>
Uses the currently selected term. Chapters added later. e.g. SUBJ Biology BI
New Term
TERM <CamelCaseName> <startDate>
e.g. TERM SecondYear 1-1-26
Custom Reminder
REMIND <CamelCaseTitle> [date] [HH:MM] [CamelCaseDesc]
e.g. REMIND PayTuitionFee in3day 18:00

Offline Backup
✕
A backup file you keep yourself — it works without an account or internet. Export saves all your sessions, subjects, terms, exams and settings to a file. Import brings a file back in and merges it, so nothing existing is deleted. For automatic online backup, use Sync & Backup from the menu.
Guide to Elvar
Underlined headings jump straight to that screen.
Dashboard
Your home screen — today's stats, what's scheduled, and quick tiles to every other screen.
Menu & Profile
Tap the menu icon for your profile, guide, settings, and sync & backup — tap the Elvar logo anytime to jump home.
Daily Log
Log a study session — subject, chapter, time, and optional notes on how it went.
Study Rhythm
A calendar plus weekly/monthly charts of your study time and exams.
Exam Radar
Add exams with subjects, chapters and a date — track upcoming, attended and missed.
Insights
Charts of time, exams and questions — per subject or chapter, filterable by term.
Terms & Subject Manager
Add your subjects and chapters, organized into terms. Elvar never comes pre-loaded — every term starts empty.
Syllabus
Every chapter in a term, with how many times you've studied or revised it. Filter by subject, or pick All Subjects for a term-wide view — turn on the performance column in Settings › Appearance to also see 👍/👎 counts pulled from your session notes.
MCQ Practice
A bubble-sheet exam simulator — practice, then see your score, time and accuracy.
MCQ Performance
History of every MCQ test you've logged, with score, time and accuracy charts.
Notes
Date-based notes. Tap + inside one to add a table, a ready-made Time/To-do/Extra routine, checkboxes, a reminder, or labels — and pin a note to the top or to your Dashboard.
Study Timer
A stopwatch or countdown for study blocks. Tap Start, or hold it to charge it up. While it runs, a notification with Pause and Save buttons stays in your notification panel. A soft chime marks every 25 minutes, a countdown buzzes lightly in its last 10 seconds, and the headphones button plays background sounds, including your own under My sounds.
Wallet
Record income and expenses by category, set a budget and watch your balance. Elvar plays a low sound the moment this month's spending passes this month's income.
Notifications
The bell shows reminders, streaks, exam countdowns and summaries. Add your own with + Reminder. An exam with a start time gets a heads-up one hour before and another at the start. Choose what you receive in the bell's settings. Tapping a notification opens the matching screen.
Settings
Show or hide dashboard tiles — hiding one never deletes the data behind it.
Sound & Vibration
Switch sounds and vibration on or off, and set Quiet Hours (for example 10 pm to 7 am) when Elvar makes no sounds or buzzes and notifications arrive silently.
How the graphs work
Bar height is relative to the tallest bar in view — tap any bar for its exact numbers.
What you can customize
• Themes, from the top bar
• Your avatar and name, from the menu
• Which dashboard tiles show, in Settings
Sync & Backup
Everything is saved on your phone first. Sign in to back it all up to your account and use Elvar on another device. Choose what to back up, pause syncing, restore or delete your cloud copy. Device info (and your location, only if you switch it on) is shared with the Elvar admin for support. The Data button on that page still exports and imports a backup file with no account needed.
Quick Tips
• 1-3.4,5 = chapters 1-3 of subject 1 + chapters 4,5 of subject 2
• Dates show as dd/mm/yyyy everywhere
• Everything is saved on your phone first. Signing in is optional and adds online backup
• Found a problem? Menu → Contact and Support → Report a problem

Privacy
When you are signed in, your data is stored in your Elvar account. Only you and the Elvar admin can access it, including the device info listed above and your location if you choose to share it. You can switch these off, log out, or delete your cloud data at any time.
Your data is always saved on this device first. Signing in also backs up everything to your account online, so you can restore it or use Elvar on another device. The Elvar admin can view account data and basic device info for support.
